label: Close-up Detail
description: A tightly-framed shot of the Flask of Bottled Momentum resting on weathered stone, highlighting the thick alchemical glass with swirling, luminescent vapor trapped inside, the heavy wax seal bearing an arcane sigil, and hairline stress fractures running through the vessel that hint at the dangerous pressure within.

label: Lifestyle Setting
description: A cloaked thief crouched in the shadows of a moonlit treasury, one gloved hand gripping the Flask of Bottled Momentum while the other reaches toward an iron-bound chest, the faint glow of captured kinetic energy illuminating their determined expression as guards' torchlight flickers in the distant corridor.

label: Overhead View
description: A flat-lay arrangement on a dark velvet cloth featuring the Flask of Bottled Momentum at center, surrounded by a shattered padlock, scattered lockpicks, a worn leather bandolier, and a handwritten note warning of the flask's volatile nature, with wisps of pressurized vapor visible through the glass.
